description: This file is a shell script that sets up and tests git submodule behavior, including creating repositories, adding files and submodules, and verifying error messages when attempting operations within submodules.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new git repository at specified location.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expected to succeed, running provided commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail, capturing error output.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual output with expected output.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in provided output.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
